name: rereadme
description: CLI tool to refresh README automatically with up-to-date information based on code contents, documents, and external sources
author: Connor Ludwig

scripts.setup: git submodule update --init evals/datasets/express-server evals/datasets/rereadme && cd evals && uv sync
scripts.eval: cd evals && NO_COLOR=1 uv run deepeval test run test_express_server.py test_rereadme.py test_express_server_agents.py test_rereadme_agents.py -v
scripts.eval:rereadme: cd evals && NO_COLOR=1 uv run deepeval test run test_rereadme.py test_rereadme_agents.py -v
scripts.eval:agents: cd evals && NO_COLOR=1 uv run deepeval test run test_express_server_agents.py test_rereadme_agents.py -v
scripts.eval:report: cd evals && NO_COLOR=1 uv run python evaluate.py
scripts.eval:ci: cd evals && uv run pytest test_ci_mode.py -v
